def: A family of architectures from Google Research (Behrouz et al., 2024) that pairs attention over the current window with a neural long-term memory module whose weights are updated at test time to memorize context.
practice: A reference design for learned test-time memory: the paper reports scaling past 2M tokens of context, and the HOPE architecture from Nested Learning (NeurIPS 2025) is a variant of it.
